title: when a slice's checker and its tests are in the same _test.go file, say in the brief that a base overlay cannot isolate the product change, so the reviewer knows the revert check is by tracing only

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261126-021914-40b1, project ork, item S609:

when a slice's checker and its tests are in the same _test.go file, say in the brief that a base overlay cannot isolate the product change, so the reviewer knows the revert check is by tracing only

Evidence: S609 changes only internal/engine/adjguard_test.go, which holds both the checker and its tests
